evidence.finding: DescribeTableReplicaAutoScaling requires a global-table member, not an ordinary regional table. Valid UpdateTableReplicaAutoScaling also returns ResourceNotFound for absent/non-global table; update-shape validation precedes existence checks.

Fresh global PAY_PER_REQUEST describes both region members and index; each unconfigured settings object is AutoScalingDisabled:true plus ScalingPolicies:[] with bounds and role absent. Enabled updates on on-demand reject.

The initial on-demand-to-provisioned R2/W2 conversion creates default table and index read/write targets/policies in both regions (min2,max40000,target70). These service-generated maxima are not actual capacity requests or observed provisioned capacity. Enabled settings omit AutoScalingDisabled, retain role/bounds, project policy name and tracking fields but omit AS metric specification/ARN/alarms.

One valid API request updates synchronized table/index write settings in both regions and selected regional read settings. The peer endpoint accepts the same global coordination. Unmentioned read dimensions remain unchanged. Customer-selected settings persist after both tables/indexes ACTIVE.

Enabled settings require MinimumUnits, MaximumUnits and ScalingPolicyUpdate even when a target and policy already exist. Bounds-only, policy-only and false-only reenable requests reject without observed side effects.
Explicit true disables by removing target/policy; complete settings with false reenable. Writes disable/reenable across both regions; regional read disable affects only selected region.
Named policy replacement preserves target ARN/CreationTime; complete settings with TargetValue-only configuration replace rather than merge prior DisableScaleIn and cooldown fields.

Invalid region/index membership errors are ResourceNotFound and leave observed projections unchanged; malformed/missing policy TargetValue is ValidationException. AAS-dependent failures are not atomic: invalid write bounds can coexist with changed regional read target bounds and deleted read policy; invalid regional target value can coexist with successfully changed synchronized write policies.
A registered AS target without a policy is projected as AutoScalingDisabled:true,ScalingPolicies:[] without its bounds/role; native AS still exposes those bounds and target identity.

Enabled replacement does not generally deregister the target: captured target ARN and CreationTime are stable. CloudTrail records RegisterScalableTarget, PutScalingPolicy and DeleteScalingPolicy dependent calls, often within the same second. Exact Delete/Put ordering or universal rollback behavior is not established.

A federated session allowed only relevant DDB table actions and explicitly denied application-autoscaling:* can describe scaling, update synchronized writes, and explicitly disable regional read scaling. Its direct AS describe is denied. DDB integration therefore must not impose customer public-AS permissions for these observed operations.

CloudTrail dependent AS reads/Register/Put use AWSServiceRoleForDynamoDBReplication assumed-role identities invokedBy replication.dynamodb.amazonaws.com. Some dependent deregistrations record customer IAMUser invokedBy dynamodb.amazonaws.com. Session permission outcomes above, not actor appearance alone, establish authorization.

After final provisioned-to-on-demand switch fully settles, Describe retains target bounds/role/policies but includes AutoScalingDisabled:true. Transitional descriptions can omit this flag; settled rows must be used. This differs from a fresh on-demand table whose settings are empty/disabled.
Explicit disable remains accepted on PAY_PER_REQUEST even under the explicit-AS-denied session and removes retained selected target/policy.

limitations: Native captures are sampled outcomes, not timing guarantees; accepted operations are distinguished from later ACTIVE/absence observations.
Only MREC global tables in us-east-1/us-east-2 with one GSI were exercised; no MRSC or legacy global-table version.
No custom IAM role ARN override or invalid role ARN matrix; default preexisting service-linked roles were not changed.
Explicit AS SuspendedState overrides and multi-policy metric mixtures were not separately exercised.
CloudTrail is eventually delivered; queries are bounded at three pages per operation/region, so absent events are not proof of absent actions. Whole-second timestamps cannot order same-second events.

Two pre-isolation shared-Eval call-signature collisions are retained as excluded tooling observations seq4-5 (UnknownOperationException, no named resource or mutation); seq60 was interrupted before a native result. All subsequent probe state isolated in rsa namespace.
AS target/policy cleanup is explicit; table deletion is not claimed to automatically remove AS resources.
Federated credentials were memory-only and redacted before capture persistence; ephemeral federation expires without an owned IAM resource.
